summary: The visible suite now passes (3 passed). I changed only `solution/core.py`. The root cause was operand order in the binary-operator branch: `a, b = pop(), pop()` made `a` the top of the stack and `b` the value beneath it, so `SUB`, `LT`, `GT`, `DIV` and `MOD` all ran with their operands reversed. That broke `1 2 LT`, let `1 0 DIV` skip the zero check, and made the countdown loop compute `1 - x` instead of `x - 1`, so it never reached zero. The fix pops the right-hand operand first and computes `left OP right`. I also fixed `SWAP`, which was a no-op because it pushed its two values back in their original order. The public API is unchanged, and nothing under `tests/` was touched. Two behaviours I left alone because the issue doesn't specify them: `DIV` and `MOD` still use Python's floor semantics for negative operands, and `JZ` still treats only `0` as zero.
